title: Production acceptance: prove pilot topology and CTA boundary
evidence_required: FT-006-AC-005 RED_NOT_APPLICABLE: this task changes no application or deployment behavior and inducing a pre-change failure in the authorized pilot boundary would falsify the accepted setup; alternative proof: an authorized evaluator records that continuation is externally reachable only through HTTPS, PostgreSQL/MinIO/internal ports remain private, and the CTA reaches only the configured absolute HTTPS target without personalized parameters or claiming that target page; decisive comparison: redacted public/private exposure receipts and observed CTA destination against the accepted boundary; artifact: evaluator record and redacted topology/CTA receipts under .tasks/TASK-082-T3-FT-006-W3/.
purpose: Make the final production-only decision that the deployed continuation topology exposes only the accepted HTTPS edge, keeps internal services private and preserves the configured external CTA boundary.
success_outcome: The authorized pilot exposes continuation only through HTTPS, keeps PostgreSQL, MinIO and internal services private, and reaches only the configured absolute HTTPS purchase target without personalized parameters.
anti_goals: Do not implement or repair application behavior, deployment, rate-limit configuration or the separate purchase/selfie-search page.
Do not mutate production secrets, participant identity, operator/default sessions, media or database state beyond the authorized controlled fixture.
Do not repeat same-session, multi-phone, media, browser-expiry or physical-join proof owned by TASK-081, and do not claim implementation of the target purchase page.

forbidden_scope: Application source, canonical contracts and deployment repair
Production secret mutation, unapproved participant data capture and raw credential/personalized payload retention
Direct public access to PostgreSQL, MinIO or internal service ports
stop_conditions: The authorized HTTPS edge or configured pilot boundary is unavailable or materially differs from the accepted setup.
The purchase target can be request-overridden or the public boundary requires a new service, allow-list framework or credential path.
The evaluator cannot retain a redacted, reproducible topology/CTA observation without credentials or personalized data.

constraints: Run only with an authorized evaluator, retain redacted evidence, and keep the configured target as a server-owned absolute HTTPS URL.
Topology and CTA artifacts omit credentials, session payloads, ticket/cookie values, personalized query data and raw storage identities.
This final task has no dependents and may remain planned until the authorized pilot edge and evaluator are available.
invariants: Continuation is externally reachable only through the accepted HTTPS edge, with no public PostgreSQL, MinIO or internal-service bypass.
CTA navigation contains no session, ticket, teaser or N parameter and reaches only the configured target.
The purchase/selfie-search target remains a separately delivered external page and is not implemented or accepted by this task.
verification_targets: Redacted pilot observations prove continuation has only the HTTPS public edge, PostgreSQL/MinIO/internal ports are private, and no direct storage/service bypass is accepted.
A redacted CTA observation proves the destination is the configured absolute HTTPS target with no session, ticket, teaser or N parameter and without accepting implementation of the target page.
